# John Valentine

> Software engineer based in Abuja, Nigeria. Builds back-end systems, automation,
> bots and Web3 applications in Python, Go, Rust and TypeScript.

## About

John Valentine is a software engineer in Abuja, Nigeria. He holds a First-Class
degree in Software Engineering and the Vice Chancellor Award. His work covers
back-end and systems programming (Python, Go, Rust/Actix Web), front-end
development (React, Next.js, JavaScript/TypeScript), blockchain and Web3
(Solidity, IPFS, Hedera), and embedded systems.

Selected work includes WeGoComply, an AI-powered KYC/AML/TIN compliance platform
for Nigerian fintechs, and an IoT smart-farm system that won an African
Telecommunication Union grant.

## Services

- Back-end development
- Automation and bot development
- Web3 and smart contracts
- Embedded systems
- AI integration
